U_0x00B2C3: An <Armored Module> based on a Galerion (Guarlion successor) prototype, tuned for the <Boosted Children>. Heavily armored, yet its <Tesla Drive> and back thrusters outdo the Asterion AX in mobility. An EW model with EA (attack), EP (defense), and ES (support) functions.
U_0x00B4DF: The Lion's successor from <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>; 'Relion (ReLION)' means 'Refined Lion.' Its human-type arms wield varied weapons, like the Guarlion. A multirole <Armored Module>: stronger than the Lion, easy to handle, maintain, and produce.
U_0x00B6B8: A humanoid weapon of unknown origin, said to be a firm's new model in disguise.
U_0x00B780:
A mass-production <Armored Module> used by the <DC> and <Colony Integ. Army> in the <DC War>; it now serves both <DC> remnants and the <Earth Fed Army> (Federation code RAM-004V). An improved, more mobile Lion.
Its '<Tesla Drive>,' a thruster splitting gravitational from inertial mass, cancels gravitational mass only; small downward jets let it hover while small wings give lift. Thrust comes separately - a large engine in the distinctive lower hull, which doubles as landing gear. Attitude thrusters below allow terrain-following and ground combat; part swaps enable use in space. It is very simple and cheap for a <Tesla Drive> craft.
Production continues at <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>; it remains an <Earth Fed Army> mainstay.
U_0x00BCF9:
A variant of the <Armored Module> Lion. Officially 'Lion Type-L'; 'Landlion' is a nickname.
Built for ground combat, its four stick movers, fitted in place of legs, give high rough-terrain mobility; leveling them lowers its profile.
Less mobile and agile than the Lion, it mainly attacks and defends ground bases, so it mounts a large rail gun stronger than the normal type's. It can fly via <Tesla Drive>, but poorly suits air combat.

&A variant of the mass-production <Armored Module> Lion used by <DC> remnants. Officially 'Lion Type-C'; 'Cosmolion' is a nickname.
Built for space combat: a large booster unit with an improved <Tesla Drive> raises top speed and range, and a missile container sits on its back. With tuning and pilot skill it can operate under gravity.
